blocks.text: Tarlac Third District Rep. Noel Rivera’s arraignment before the Sandiganbayan Fifth Division has been reset to Oct. 7. pending the resolution of his motion to quash the information charging him with graft over alleged conflict of interest in infrastructure projects.
